name: Claude's Songbook
description: An album of original compositions across the world's music: a nocturne and a canon, bossa, blues and tango, gamelan, raga and koto, Afrobeat and funk, house, drum and bass, synthwave and trap, choirs, storms, forests and space stations. Every piece is a complete song, with an intro, sections that come and go, variations, a change of tempo where the music asks for one, and a real ending.
author: Claude, for Tartlet

sketches.name: Rain Nocturne
sketches.description: A piano nocturne in D-flat in ternary form: rolling left-hand arpeggios, a singing theme, a searching middle section, the theme's return and a coda that slows to rest, with rain on the window.
sketches.source:
setcpm(66/4)
song("intro@4 theme@8 middle@8 theme'@8 coda@4", "once")
tempomap("0:16.5 28:16.5 32:11")

// Left hand: rolling broken chords through Db, Bbm, Gb and Ab
left: note("<[db2 ab2 f3 ab2 db3 ab2 f3 ab2] [bb1 f2 db3 f2 bb2 f2 db3 f2] [gb1 db2 bb2 db2 gb2 db2 bb2 db2] [ab1 eb2 c3 eb2 ab2 eb2 c3 eb2]>")
  .s("triangle").timbre("soft")
  .attack(.005).decay(.9).sustain(.15).release(1.2)
  .lpf(1800).room(.6).size(.8).gain(bysec("intro:.3 middle:.42 *:.38"))
  .exceptSections("coda")

// The coda comes home to Db and lets the last chord ring
home: note("<[db2 ab2 f3 ab2 db3 ab2 f3 ab2] [gb1 db2 bb2 db2 gb2 db2 bb2 db2] [db2 ab2 f3 ab2 db3 ab2 f3 ab2] [db2,ab2,f3,db4]>")
  .s("triangle").timbre("soft")
  .attack(.005).decay(.9).sustain(.15).release(2)
  .lpf(1600).room(.7).size(.9).gain(.32)
  .sections("coda")

// Right hand: the theme; its last two phrases lift an octave,
// and when it returns a soft fifth shadows every note
right: note("<[f4@3 eb4 db4@2 eb4 f4] [db5@4 c5@2 bb4 ab4] [bb4@3 ab4 gb4@2 f4 eb4] [eb4@2 f4 gb4 f4@4]>")
  .s("sine").fm(.8).fmh(2)
  .attack(.01).decay(1.4).sustain(.2).release(1.5)
  .atEnd(2, x => x.add(12))
  .gain(.5)
  .off(1/16, x => x.add(12).gain(.12))
  .room(.65).size(.85)
  .sections("theme").variant(x => x.off(1/8, y => y.add(7).gain(.08)))

// The middle section: the melody climbs and searches over the same chords
middle: note("<[db5@3 c5 bb4@2 ab4 bb4] [f5@4 eb5@2 db5 c5] [db5@3 c5 bb4@2 ab4 gb4] [ab4@4 c5@2 eb5@2]>")
  .s("sine").fm(.8).fmh(2)
  .attack(.01).decay(1.4).sustain(.2).release(1.5)
  .gain(.46).room(.7).size(.85)
  .sections("middle")

// A last phrase over the coda
farewell: note("<[f4@3 eb4 db4@4] [db4@2 eb4@2 gb4@4] [f4@8] ~>")
  .s("sine").fm(.8).fmh(2)
  .attack(.01).decay(2).sustain(.2).release(2.5)
  .gain(.42).room(.7).size(.9)
  .sections("coda")

// Rain on the window, heaviest in the middle of the piece
rain: s("rain").slow(4).intensity(.4).gain(env(".12 .28@3 .12", "song"))

sketches.name: Clockwork Canon
sketches.description: A three-voice canon over a repeating ground. The ground plays alone first, the canon runs twice (the second time with the bass moving in eighths) and a cadence closes it. Every melody uses only chord tones, so each delayed voice fits the one before it.
sketches.source:
setcpm(70/4)
song("ground@4 canon@16 canon'@16 coda@4", "once")
tempomap("0:17.5 36:17.5 40:12")

// The ground: C G Am Em F C F G, two notes per chord
const theme = note("<[e5 g5 d5 b4 c5 e5 b4 g4 a4 c5 g4 e4 a4 f4 g4 b4] [c5 e5 b4 d5 e5 a5 g5 e5 f5 a5 e5 g5 c5 a4 b4 d5] [g5 e5 d5 g5 a5 e5 b5 g5 a5 f5 g5 c6 a5 f5 d5 b4] [c5@2 b4@2 a4@2 g4@2 f4@2 e4@2 f4 a4 g4 b4]>")

// First violin states each variation
violin1: theme.s("sawtooth").vib(5.5).vibdepth(.12)
  .attack(.03).decay(.2).sustain(.6).release(.15)
  .lpf(3200).pan(.3).room(.5).gain(.24)
  .sections("canon")

// Second violin follows one cycle behind, an octave down
violin2: theme.late(1).add(-12).s("sawtooth").vib(5).vibdepth(.1)
  .attack(.03).decay(.2).sustain(.6).release(.15)
  .lpf(2600).pan(.7).room(.5).gain(.22)
  .sections("canon")

// Viola enters two cycles behind, a softer reed colour
viola: theme.late(2).add(-12).s("triangle").timbre("reed")
  .attack(.03).sustain(.5).release(.2).room(.5).gain(.14)
  .sections("canon")

// Cello walks the ground bass, harpsichord fills in the harmony;
// the second time through, both move twice as fast
cello: note("c3 g2 a2 e2 f2 c2 f2 g2").s("sawtooth").lpf(700)
  .attack(.04).decay(.3).sustain(.5).release(.2).room(.4).gain(.32)
  .exceptSections("coda").variant(x => x.ply(2))
harpsichord: note("[c4,e4,g4] [b3,d4,g4] [a3,c4,e4] [b3,e4,g4] [a3,c4,f4] [g3,c4,e4] [a3,c4,f4] [b3,d4,g4]")
  .s("square").pw(.15).attack(.002).decay(.2).sustain(0).release(.1)
  .lpf(3000).room(.3).gain(.12)
  .exceptSections("coda").variant(x => x.ply(2))

// Coda: the whole consort lands on a final cadence, F, G, C
cadence: note("<[a3,c4,f4,a4] [g3,d4,g4,b4] [g3,c4,e4,c5] [c3,g3,c4,e4,c5]>")
  .s("sawtooth").vib(5).vibdepth(.1)
  .attack(.05).sustain(.7).release(1.5)
  .lpf(2400).room(.6).gain(.2)
  .sections("coda")
cellocoda: note("<f2 g2 c2 c2>").s("sawtooth").lpf(700)
  .attack(.04).sustain(.7).release(1.5).room(.5).gain(.32)
  .sections("coda")

sketches.name: Phase Garden
sketches.description: Minimalism after Steve Reich: one piano sets the pulse, a second with figures of eleven notes drifts apart and back, a marimba and rotating clappers join, and the first piano is left alone at the end.

sketches.name: Moon Lullaby
sketches.description: A music-box waltz in 3/4: the box plays alone, the oom-pah-pah joins, a parent hums a verse, everyone sings together, and the music box winds down to sleep with crickets outside.
sketches.source:
setcpm(72/3)
song("intro@8 verse@16 hum@8 verse'@16 goodnight@8", "once")
// The music box winds down over the last eight bars
tempomap("0:24 48:24 56:14")

// One cycle is a bar of 3/4
// Music box melody: C G F C Dm F G C
musicbox: note("<[e5 g5 c6] [b5@2 g5] [a5 c6 a5] [g5@3] [f5 a5 d6] [c6@2 a5] [g5 b5 d6] [c6@3]>")
  .s("sine").fm(2).fmh(4)
  .attack(.002).decay(.8).sustain(0).release(1)
  .room(.6).size(.8).gain(bysec("goodnight:.22 *:.3"))
  .exceptSections("hum")
  .variant(x => x.superimpose(y => y.add(-12).gain(.12)))

// Oom-pah-pah on a soft keyboard
waltz: note("<[c3 [e3,g3] [e3,g3]] [g2 [b2,d3] [b2,d3]] [f2 [a2,c3] [a2,c3]] [c3 [e3,g3] [e3,g3]] [d3 [f3,a3] [f3,a3]] [f2 [a2,c3] [a2,c3]] [g2 [b2,d3] [b2,f3]] [c3 [e3,g3] ~]>")
  .s("triangle").timbre("soft")
  .attack(.005).decay(.4).sustain(0).release(.3).gain(.28)
  .exceptSections("intro")

// A parent humming along, an octave down: alone first, then with the box
hum: note("<e4 d4 c4 e4 f4 a4 g4 c4>").s("hum").attack(.5).release(1.5).gain(.22)
  .sections("hum verse'")

// Crickets outside the nursery window
crickets: s("insect").slow(4).distance(6).gain(.1)

sketches.name: The Tempest
sketches.description: A cinematic storm in D minor in five sections: calm, gathering, two waves of storm and the aftermath. A power-fifth string ostinato descends while timpani, brass, choir and wind build to a climax and fade.
sketches.source:
setcpm(90/4)
song("calm@8 gathering@8 storm@8 storm'@8 aftermath@8", "once")
tempomap("0:22.5 32:22.5 40:15")

// Strings: a driving root-and-fifth ostinato stepping down D, C, Bb, A,
// opening up across the whole storm
strings: note("d3 d3 a3 d3 a2 d3 a3 d3").add("<0 0 -2 -2 -4 -4 -5 -5>")
  .s("sawtooth").unison(2).detune(.15)
  .attack(.01).decay(.12).sustain(.4).release(.08)
  .lpf(env("800 1400 3000@2 900", "song")).room(.4)
  .gain(bysec("calm:.18 aftermath:.2 *:.28"))

// Brass: open, heroic chords from the gathering onward
brass: note("<[d3,a3,d4] ~ [c3,g3,c4] ~ [bb2,f3,bb3] [bb2,f3,d4] [a2,e3,a3] [a2,e3,a3]>")
  .s("sawtooth").unison(3).detune(.2)
  .lpf(900).lpenv(2.5).lpattack(.15)
  .attack(.15).release(1).room(.6).gain(.28)
  .exceptSections("calm")

// Timpani: single strokes, a roll that grows, then thunder;
// the second wave of the storm hits twice as hard
strokes: s("<lt ~ ~ ~ lt ~ lt ~>").speed(.7).lpf(900).room(.7).gain(.5)
  .sections("calm aftermath")
roll: s("<[lt ~ ~ ~] [lt ~ lt ~] [lt ~ lt lt] [lt lt lt [lt lt]] [lt lt lt lt] [lt lt lt [lt lt]] [lt*6] [lt*8]>")
  .speed(.7).lpf(900).room(.7).gain(.55)
  .sections("gathering")
thunder: s("bd lt bd lt").speed(.7).lpf(900).room(.7).gain(.6)
  .atEnd(1, x => x.ply(2))
  .sections("storm").variant(x => x.ply(2))
cymbals: s("<cr ~ ~ ~>").room(.8).gain(.4).sections("storm")

// The choir arrives with the storm, then mourns in the aftermath
choir: note("<[d4,f4,bb4] [d4,f4,bb4] [c#4,e4,a4] [c#4,e4,g4,a4]>")
  .s("choir").syl("ah").attack(.4).release(1.5).room(.7).gain(.35)
  .sections("storm")
lament: note("<[d4,f4,bb4] [c#4,e4,a4] [d4,f4,a4] [d4,f4,a4]>").slow(2)
  .s("choir").syl("oo").attack(1).release(3).room(.8).gain(.3)
  .sections("aftermath")

// Wind rises and falls across the whole arc
wind: s("pink").hpf(300).lpf(env("400 900 2500@2 600", "song"))
  .gain(env(".04 .1 .3@2 .06", "song")).pan(sine.slow(3))

sketches.name: Midnight Bossa
sketches.description: Bossa nova on ii-V-I-VI in song form: the clave and guitar alone, a flute head, a vibraphone solo, the head again doubled an octave down, a second solo and a last Dm9 that rings out.
sketches.source:
setcpm(136/8)
song("intro@4 head@8 solo@8 head'@8 solo'@8 outro@4 fine@2", "once")
tempomap("0:17 36:17 42:12")

// One cycle is two bars. Bossa clave on the rim, brushed shaker, soft surdo kick
perc: stack(
  s("rim ~ ~ rim ~ ~ rim ~ ~ ~ rim ~ ~ rim ~ ~").gain(.45),
  s("hh*16").hpf(6000).gain(saw.range(.12, .28).fast(8)),
  s("bd ~ ~ bd bd ~ ~ bd bd ~ ~ bd bd ~ ~ bd").lpf(260).gain(.55)
).exceptSections("fine")

// Nylon-string comping: Dm9, G13, Cmaj9, A7b9
guitar: note("<[f3,a3,c4,e4] [f3,b3,e4,a4] [e3,g3,b3,d4] [g3,bb3,c#4,e4]>")
  .struct("~ ~ x ~ x ~ ~ x ~ ~ x ~ x ~ ~ x")
  .s("triangle").timbre("soft")
  .attack(.003).decay(.35).sustain(0).release(.3)
  .lpf(2400).pan(.4).room(.35).gain(.3)
  .exceptSections("fine")

// Upright bass: root on the dotted quarter, fifth on the and
bass: note("<[d2@3 a1]*4 [g1@3 d2]*4 [c2@3 g1]*4 [a1@3 e2]*4>")
  .s("sine").shape(.15).decay(.4).sustain(.3).release(.15).gain(.6)
  .exceptSections("intro fine")

// A breathy flute plays the head; the second time it is doubled an octave down
flute: note("<[e5@2 d5 c5 a4@3 ~] [f5@2 e5 d5 b4@3 ~] [e5@3 d5 b4@2 g4 a4] [bb4@2 a4 g4 c#5@3 ~]>")
  .s("sine").timbre("hollow")
  .vib(5).vibdepth(.12).attack(.05).sustain(.6).release(.4)
  .pan(.6).delay(.3).delaytime(3/16).room(.5).gain(.32)
  .sections("head").variant(x => x.superimpose(y => y.add(-12).gain(.14)))

// Vibraphone solo through the chord tones; the prime gives the second solo new choices
vibes: note("<[a4 c5 e5 f5 e5 c5 a4 g4] [b4 d5 f5 a5 g5 f5 d5 b4] [g4 b4 d5 e5 d5 b4 g4 e4] [c#5 e5 g5 bb5 a5 g5 e5 c#5]>")
  .s("sine").fm(1.5).fmh(4).decay(.5).sustain(0).release(.6)
  .degradeBy(.3).seed("vibes")
  .pan(.6).room(.4).gain(.26)
  .sections("solo")

// The last chord: Dm9 over a low D, left to ring
lastchord: note("[d2,f3,a3,c4,e4]").s("triangle").timbre("soft")
  .attack(.01).decay(2).sustain(.3).release(3).room(.5).gain(.32)
  .mask("<1 0>").sections("fine")

sketches.name: Twelve-Bar Shuffle
sketches.description: Five choruses of twelve-bar blues in A: the harmonica takes the head twice, a guitar takes two solo choruses, the harp returns, and a V-IV-I turnaround ends it. Boogie bass, triplet ride and organ stabs on two and four throughout.
sketches.source:
setcpm(96/4)
song("intro@4 head@12 head'@12 solo@12 solo'@12 head''@12 ending@4", "once")
tempomap("0:24 64:24 68:16")

// Twelve-bar shuffle in A: every chord is its own bar
const a7 = note("[a1@2 a1] [c#2@2 c#2] [e2@2 e2] [f#2@2 e2]")
const d7 = note("[d2@2 d2] [f#2@2 f#2] [a2@2 a2] [b2@2 a2]")
const e7 = note("[e2@2 e2] [g#2@2 g#2] [b2@2 b2] [c#3@2 b2]")
const ka = note("[g3,a3,c#4,e4]")
const kd = note("[f#3,a3,c4,d4]")
const ke = note("[g#3,b3,d4,e4]")

// Boogie bass walking the changes; every chorus starts the form again
bass: cat(a7, a7, a7, a7, d7, d7, a7, a7, e7, d7, a7, e7)
  .s("sawtooth").lpf(650).lpq(2).decay(.25).sustain(.4).release(.1).gain(.5)
  .exceptSections("ending")

// The ending turns around V, IV, I and holds the last A
bassend: cat(e7, d7, a7, note("a1@3 ~"))
  .s("sawtooth").lpf(650).lpq(2).decay(.25).sustain(.4).release(.3).gain(.5)
  .sections("ending")

// Shuffle drums: triplet ride, backbeat and a lazy kick, with a fill to close each chorus
drums: s("[bd@2 ~] [~@2 bd] [bd@2 ~] [~@2 bd?0.5], ~ sd ~ sd, [rd@2 rd]*4")
  .room(.25).gain(.7)
  .atEnd(1, x => x.ply(2))

// Organ stabs on two and four, pushed by a triplet
organ: cat(ka, ka, ka, ka, kd, kd, ka, ka, ke, kd, ka, ke)
  .struct("~ [~@2 x] ~ [~@2 x]")
  .s("sawtooth").timbre("organ").lpf(1800)
  .decay(.3).sustain(.3).release(.15).pan(.35).gain(.25)
  .exceptSections("intro ending")
organend: cat(ke, kd, ka, ka)
  .struct("~ [~@2 x] ~ [~@2 x]")
  .s("sawtooth").timbre("organ").lpf(1800)
  .decay(.3).sustain(.3).release(.4).pan(.35).gain(.25)
  .sections("ending")

// Harmonica answers in the blues scale, and wails harder when it comes back
harp: n("<[~ [~@2 6] [7@2 6] [4@2 3]] [[2@2 0] 0 ~ ~] [~ [3@2 4] [6@2 4] [3@2 2]] [0 ~ ~ [~@2 3]]>")
  .scale("A:blues").transpose(12)
  .s("sawtooth").timbre("reed").vowel("o")
  .mono(1).glide(.05).vib(5.5).vibdepth(.3)
  .attack(.03).sustain(.6).release(.2)
  .lpf(2600).pan(.65).room(.4).gain(.32)
  .sections("head ending").variant(x => x.vowel("a").gain(.36))

// Guitar solo: two choruses, the second in double time
guitar: n("<[0 [~@2 2] [3@2 4] [6@2 7]] [[7@2 6] 4 [3@2 2] 0] [~ [7@2 9] [10@2 9] [7@2 6]] [[4@2 3] 2 0 ~]>")
  .scale("A:blues").transpose(12)
  .s("square").pw(.3).shape(.3)
  .attack(.005).decay(.3).sustain(.3).release(.15)
  .lpf(3000).pan(.6).room(.35).gain(.24)
  .sections("solo").variant(x => x.ply(2))

sketches.name: Tango de Medianoche
sketches.description: Tango nuevo in D minor in A-B-A-B form: bandoneon chords on the 3-3-2 rhythm and a marcato bass under a passionate violin, a bandoneon solo, the violin an octave higher on its return, and a coda that slows home.
sketches.source:
setcpm(116/4)
song("intro@4 a@16 b@8 a'@16 b'@8 coda@4", "once")
tempomap("0:29 52:29 56:20")

// Bandoneon chords on the 3-3-2: Dm, Gm, A7, Dm
bandoneon: note("<[d3,f3,a3] [d3,g3,bb3] [c#3,e3,g3,a3] [d3,f3,a3]>")
  .struct("x ~ ~ x ~ ~ x ~")
  .s("sawtooth").timbre("reed").unison(2).detune(.15)
  .attack(.01).decay(.2).sustain(.3).release(.1)
  .lpf(2000).pan(.4).gain(.3)

// Marcato bass with a chromatic climb home
bass: note("<[d2 ~ a1 ~ d2 ~ a1 ~] [g1 ~ d2 ~ g1 ~ d2 ~] [a1 ~ e2 ~ a1 ~ c#2 ~] [d2 ~ a1 ~ d2 [a1 bb1] [b1 c#2] d2]>")
  .s("triangle").attack(.003).decay(.2).sustain(.2).release(.1).gain(.55)
  .exceptSections("intro")

// The violin: long, aching notes and a flattened ninth over the A7;
// it returns an octave higher
violin: note("<[a4@3 bb4 a4@2 g#4 a4] [d5@4 c5 bb4 a4 g4] [f4@2 e4 f4 g4@2 a4 bb4] [a4@6 ~@2]>")
  .s("sawtooth").vib(6).vibdepth(.2)
  .attack(.08).sustain(.7).release(.3)
  .lpf(3500).pan(.6).room(.5).gain(.28)
  .sections("a").variant(x => x.add(12))

// The B section: the bandoneon takes the melody
solo: note("<[d4 e4 f4 g4 a4@2 bb4 a4] [g4@2 bb4 d5 c5@2 bb4 a4] [g4 a4 bb4 c#5 e5@2 d5 c#5] [d5@4 a4@2 f4 d4]>")
  .s("sawtooth").timbre("reed").vib(5).vibdepth(.15)
  .attack(.02).sustain(.6).release(.15)
  .lpf(2600).pan(.45).room(.4).gain(.28)
  .sections("b").variant(x => x.add(12))

// Knocks on the body of the bandoneon
knocks: s("rim ~ ~ rim ~ ~ rim ~").lpf(1500).gain(.2)

sketches.name: Gamelan Garden
sketches.description: A Balinese-style gamelan in a pelog-like scale: a gong cycle, a balungan core melody and two kotekan parts that interlock into one shimmering line. The tempo breathes like a real ensemble, quickening into the busy ngecet and slowing to a stop.
sketches.source:
setcpm(100/4)
song("buka@4 pengawak@16 ngecet@16 pengawak'@8 suwuk@4", "once")
// The tempo quickens into the ngecet, eases back, then slows for the end
tempomap("0:20 4:20 20:25 36:32 44:25 48:14")

// A pelog-flavoured scale: e f g b c
// The gong marks each four-cycle phrase
gong: note("<e2 ~ ~ ~>").s("sine").fm(1.4).fmh(1.41)
  .decay(4).sustain(0).release(4).room(.7).size(.9).gain(.45)

// Balungan: the core melody on the metallophones, doubled in speed when it returns
balungan: note("<[e4 f4 g4 f4] [e4 c4 b3 e4] [g4 b4 c5 b4] [g4 f4 e4 ~]>")
  .s("sine").fm(2.2).fmh(3.5).decay(.9).sustain(0).release(1)
  .room(.5).gain(.35)
  .variant(x => x.ply(2))

// Kotekan: polos and sangsih fill each other's gaps exactly
polos: note("e5 ~ f5 e5 ~ e5 ~ f5 e5 ~ f5 e5 ~ e5 ~ f5")
  .s("sine").fm(3).fmh(5.4).decay(.25).sustain(0).release(.3)
  .pan(.3).gain(.22)
  .sections("ngecet pengawak'")
sangsih: note("~ g5 ~ ~ g5 ~ b5 ~ ~ g5 ~ ~ g5 ~ b5 ~")
  .s("sine").fm(3).fmh(5.4).decay(.25).sustain(0).release(.3)
  .pan(.7).gain(.22)
  .sections("ngecet pengawak'")

// Kendang drums and the kempli time-keeper
kendang: s("lt ~ [~ lt] mt, ~ ~ ht ~, ~ rim ~ rim")
  .every(4, fast(2)).room(.3).gain(.4)
  .exceptSections("buka")

sketches.name: Kyoto Dawn
sketches.description: Koto plucks in the Japanese in scale, a gliding shakuhachi, a temple bell and water over stones: mist, a koto solo, a duet that returns an octave higher, and dusk.
sketches.source:
setcpm(60/4)
song("mist@4 koto@8 duet@8 duet'@8 dusk@4", "once")
tempomap("0:15 28:15 32:10")

// Koto plucks in the in scale: d eb g a bb; the second duet lifts an octave
koto: note("<[d4 eb4 g4 a4 bb4@2 a4 g4] [d5@2 bb4 a4 g4@2 eb4 d4] [a3 bb3 d4 eb4 g4@3 ~] [eb4 d4 bb3 a3 d4@4]>")
  .s("triangle").timbre("bright")
  .attack(.002).decay(.5).sustain(0).release(.6)
  .pan(.35).delay(.25).delaytime(3/8).room(.6).gain(.38)
  .sections("koto duet").variant(x => x.add(12))

// Shakuhachi: long breathy notes that bend between pitches
flute: note("<a4 [g4@3 eb4] d4 ~ bb4 [a4@3 g4] a4 ~>")
  .s("sine").timbre("hollow").mono(1).glide(.15)
  .vib(4.5).vibdepth(.25).attack(.3).sustain(.7).release(1.2)
  .pan(.65).room(.8).size(.9).gain(.32)
  .sections("duet dusk")

// A low open fifth and a distant temple bell
drone: note("[d2,a2]").slow(4).s("sine").attack(2).sustain(1).release(3).gain(.2)
bell: note("<d3 ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~>").s("sine").fm(3).fmh(2.76)
  .decay(4).sustain(0).release(4).room(.9).size(.95).gain(.22)

// Water over stones, louder in the stillness at either end
stream: s("stream").slow(4).gain(env(".3 .2@3 .3", "song"))

sketches.name: Desert Caravan
sketches.description: E Phrygian dominant: maqsum on the darbuka, an oud riff, an ornamented ney flute and hot wind across the dunes. The caravan sets out, quickens through the second ney solo and comes to rest at the oasis.
sketches.source:
setcpm(104/4)
song("dunes@4 caravan@8 ney@16 caravan'@8 ney'@16 oasis@4", "once")
// The caravan quickens through the second ney solo, then rests at the oasis
tempomap("0:26 36:26 52:30 56:20")

// Maqsum on the darbuka: doum on the low drum, tek on the rim, a roll to close each section
darbuka: s("lt rim ~ rim lt ~ rim ~")
  .sometimesBy(.25, x => x.ply(2))
  .lpf(2500).room(.3).gain(.55)
  .atEnd(1, x => x.ply(2))
  .exceptSections("dunes oasis")
fingers: s("hh*16?0.35").hpf(5000).gain(.18).sections("ney")

// A reedy drone on E and B
drone: note("[e2,b2]").s("sawtooth").timbre("reed")
  .lpf(700).attack(.4).sustain(1).release(1).gain(.22)

// Oud riff in E Phrygian dominant: e f g# a b c d; an octave up on the return
oud: note("<[e3 f3 g#3 a3 b3 a3 g#3 f3] [e3 ~ e3 f3 e3 d3 e3 ~] [a3 b3 c4 b3 a3 g#3 f3 g#3] [f3 e3 d3 f3 e3@4]>")
  .s("triangle").timbre("bright")
  .attack(.002).decay(.3).sustain(0).release(.2)
  .pan(.4).gain(.38)
  .sections("caravan ney").variant(x => x.add(12))

// Ney flute, ornamented with glides
ney: note("<[b4@3 c5 b4@2 a4 g#4] [a4@4 g#4 f4 e4@2] [e5@2 d5 c5 b4@3 a4] [g#4 a4 g#4 f4 e4@4]>")
  .s("sine").timbre("reed").vowel("o")
  .mono(1).glide(.07).vib(5).vibdepth(.25)
  .attack(.06).sustain(.7).release(.4)
  .pan(.6).delay(.3).delaytime(3/8).room(.6).gain(.3)
  .sections("ney oasis")

// Hot wind across the dunes
wind: s("wind").slow(8).gain(.14)

sketches.name: Highland Jig
sketches.description: A jig in true 6/8 and AABB form, played through twice: a fiddle tune in D with its higher B strain, a tin whistle joining the second time round, bodhran, guitar, pipe drones and a final chord.
sketches.source:
setcpm(116/2)
song("intro@2 (a@8)*2 (b@8)*2 (a'@8)*2 (b'@8)*2 tag@2", "once")
tempomap("0:58 66:58 68:40")

// One cycle is a bar of 6/8: two groups of three
// The A strain; a tin whistle doubles it when the tune comes round again
fiddle: note("<[d4 f#4 a4 d5 a4 f#4] [g4 b4 d5 b4 a4 g4] [f#4 a4 d5 e5 f#5 e5] [d5 b4 a4 [f#4 e4] d4 ~]>")
  .s("sawtooth").timbre("reed").lpf(3200)
  .vib(6).vibdepth(.12).attack(.02).decay(.2).sustain(.5).release(.1)
  .gain(.32)
  .sections("a").variant(x => x.superimpose(y => y.add(12).s("sine").gain(.14)))

// The B strain climbs higher
fiddleb: note("<[a4 d5 f#5 a5 f#5 d5] [b4 d5 g5 b5 a5 g5] [f#5 e5 d5 e5 f#5 a5] [g5 e5 c#5 [e5 c#5] d5 ~]>")
  .s("sawtooth").timbre("reed").lpf(3200)
  .vib(6).vibdepth(.12).attack(.02).decay(.2).sustain(.5).release(.1)
  .gain(.32)
  .sections("b").variant(x => x.superimpose(y => y.add(12).s("sine").gain(.14)))

// Bodhran: lift on the first of each three
bodhran: s("lt ~ lt lt ~ lt, ~ ~ ~ mt ~ ~").lpf(1200).room(.3).gain(.5)
  .exceptSections("tag")

// Guitar in the jig rhythm
guitar: note("<[d3,f#3,a3] [g3,b3,d4] [d3,f#3,a3] [a2,c#3,e3,g3]>")
  .struct("x ~ x x ~ x").s("triangle")
  .attack(.003).decay(.2).sustain(0).release(.15).pan(.35).gain(.28)
  .exceptSections("intro tag")

// Pipe drones under everything
drones: note("[d2,a2,d3]").s("sawtooth").timbre("reed")
  .lpf(900).attack(.2).sustain(1).release(.5).gain(.16)

// The tag: one last chord from the whole band
last: note("[d3,a3,d4,f#4,a4]").struct("<[x ~ ~ ~ ~ ~] ~>")
  .s("sawtooth").timbre("reed").lpf(2400)
  .attack(.01).decay(1).sustain(.4).release(1.5).room(.4).gain(.3)
  .sections("tag")

sketches.name: Lagos Engine
sketches.description: Afrobeat that builds and breaks: the bell alone, then shekere, a restless bass and two interlocking guitars, a horn section's call and answer, a stripped-down break, the horns again in double time and a final band hit.
sketches.source:
setcpm(112/4)
song("bell@4 groove@16 horns@16 break@8 horns'@16 outro@7 end@1", "once")

// The bell holds the whole band together
bell: s("rim").struct("x ~ x ~ x x ~ x ~ x ~ x x ~ x ~").hpf(1500).gain(.35)
  .exceptSections("end")
shekere: s("hh*16").hpf(6000).gain(sine.range(.12, .3).fast(4))
  .exceptSections("bell end")

// Kit: syncopated kick, backbeat snare, open hats on the off-beats, a fill to close each section
drums: s("bd ~ ~ bd ~ ~ bd ~ bd ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ bd ~, ~ ~ ~ ~ sd ~ ~ sd?0.3 ~ ~ ~ ~ sd ~ ~ ~, ~ ~ oh ~ ~ ~ oh ~ ~ ~ oh ~ ~ ~ oh ~")
  .gain(.65)
  .atEnd(1, x => x.ply(2))
  .exceptSections("bell break end")

// A bass line that never stops moving
bass: note("e2 ~ ~ e2 ~ g2 ~ a2 ~ ~ e2 ~ d2 ~ b1 d2")
  .s("sawtooth").lpf(700).lpq(3).decay(.2).sustain(.4).release(.08).gain(.5)
  .exceptSections("bell end")

// Two guitars locking together: one scratchy, one picking
scratch: note("[~ e4 ~ e4 ~ [e4 g4] ~ e4]*2")
  .s("square").pw(.2).hpf(800).decay(.08).sustain(0).pan(.3).gain(.18)
  .exceptSections("bell end")
pick: note("b3 d4 e4 ~ b3 d4 ~ g4 b3 d4 e4 ~ a3 ~ b3 d4")
  .s("triangle").timbre("bright").decay(.12).sustain(0).pan(.7).gain(.24)
  .exceptSections("bell break end")

// Horn section: a call, then the answer; twice as busy when it returns
horns: note("<[~@3 [g4,b4,e5] ~ [g4,b4,e5] ~@2] [~@3 [a4,d5,f#5]@2 [g4,b4,e5]@3]>")
  .s("sawtooth").unison(2).detune(.1)
  .lpf(1200).lpenv(2).lpattack(.03).lpdecay(.2)
  .attack(.02).release(.15).room(.3).gain(.28)
  .sections("horns").variant(x => x.ply(2))

// The band's last hit
hit: note("[e2,b2,e3,g3,b3,d4]").struct("x ~ ~ ~")
  .s("sawtooth").unison(2).detune(.1).lpf(1500)
  .attack(.01).decay(.6).sustain(0).release(.4).room(.4).gain(.3)
  .sections("end")
hitkit: s("[bd,cr] ~ ~ ~").gain(.6).sections("end")

sketches.name: Evening Raga
sketches.description: Raga Yaman at dusk, from a slow unmetred alap through the pulsing jor and the gat with tabla to a racing jhala and a closing tihai, over a ringing tanpura. The tempo gathers speed throughout.
sketches.source:
setcpm(72/4)
song("alap@8 jor@8 gat@16 jhala@8 tihai@2", "once")
// The raga gathers speed from the slow alap to the racing jhala
tempomap("0:14 8:16 16:18 32:20 40:24 42:18")

// Raga Yaman: the lydian colour of the raised fourth
// Tanpura: pa, sa, sa, low sa, ringing on and on
tanpura: note("g2 c3 c3 c2").slow(2).s("sawtooth").timbre("bright")
  .unison(2).detune(.08).attack(.01).decay(2).sustain(.4).release(2.5)
  .lpf(1800).room(.6).gain(.22)

// Alap: the sitar explores the phrases slowly, without a pulse
alap: n("<[-1 1 2@2 1 2 3@2] [4@4 3 2 1 2] [3 4 5 6 7@2 6 5] [4 3 2 1 0@4]>").slow(2)
  .scale("C:lydian").transpose(12)
  .s("sawtooth").timbre("bright").mono(1).glide(.15)
  .vib(6).vibdepth(.2).penv(1).pdecay(.03)
  .attack(.003).decay(.8).sustain(.4).release(.5)
  .lpf(3200).pan(.55).room(.6).gain(.26)
  .sections("alap")

// Sitar: phrases that climb ni re ga, then fall back home; doubled in the jhala
sitar: n("<[-1 1 2@2 1 2 3@2] [4@4 3 2 1 2] [3 4 5 6 7@2 6 5] [4 3 2 1 0@4]>")
  .scale("C:lydian").transpose(12)
  .ply(bysec("jhala:2 *:1"))
  .s("sawtooth").timbre("bright").mono(1).glide(.1)
  .vib(6).vibdepth(.15).penv(1).pdecay(.03)
  .attack(.003).decay(.5).sustain(.4).release(.3)
  .lpf(3500).pan(.55).room(.5).gain(.28)
  .sections("jor gat jhala")

// Tihai: one phrase played three times, landing on sa
tihai: n("<[[2 1 0] [2 1 0] [2 1 0] ~] 0>")
  .scale("C:lydian").transpose(12)
  .s("sawtooth").timbre("bright").penv(1).pdecay(.03)
  .attack(.003).decay(.5).sustain(.4).release(1.5)
  .lpf(3500).pan(.55).room(.5).gain(.3)
  .sections("tihai")

// Tabla: bayan below, dayan and rim above, from the gat onward
tabla: s("lt ht [~ ht] ht, ~ ~ rim ~, ~ [~ lt] ~ ~")
  .speed(1.2).sometimesBy(.2, x => x.ply(2)).room(.3).gain(.42)
  .sections("gat jhala tihai")

sketches.name: Neon Boulevard
sketches.description: Synthwave in full song form: pad and arpeggio intro, a verse with a low melody, a chorus lead, a riser bridge, a bigger last chorus with an octave shimmer and an outro, over gated drums and a pumping octave bass.
sketches.source:
setcpm(100/4)
song("intro@8 verse@16 chorus@16 bridge@8 chorus'@16 outro@8", "once")

// Gated drums: four on the floor, a huge snare and pumping hats, with a fill at each section end
drums: stack(
  s("bd*4").shape(.2).gain(.8),
  s("~ sd ~ sd").room(.6).size(.85).gain(.55),
  s("hh*8").hpf(7000).gain(saw.range(.15, .35).fast(4))
).atEnd(1, x => x.ply(2))
  .exceptSections("intro bridge outro")

// Driving eighth-note bass through Am, F, C, G with an octave echo,
// its filter opening through every section
bass: note("<a1 f1 c2 g1>").ply(8)
  .s("sawtooth").lpf(env("400 1400", "section")).lpq(4).lpenv(2).lpdecay(.1)
  .decay(.15).sustain(.3).release(.05).gain(.45)
  .off(1/16, x => x.add(12).gain(.2))
  .exceptSections("intro outro")

// A wide pad holding the chords
pad: note("<[a3,c4,e4] [f3,a3,c4] [c4,e4,g4] [g3,b3,d4]>")
  .s("sawtooth").unison(4).detune(.3)
  .attack(.4).release(1.5).lpf(1800).room(.7).gain(.22)

// Sequenced arpeggio following the roots
arp: n("[0 2 4 7]*2").add("<0 5 2 6>").scale("A:minor").transpose(12)
  .s("square").pw(.3).decay(.08).sustain(0)
  .delay(.4).delaytime(3/16).delayfeedback(.45).gain(.18)

// The verse melody: low and patient
verse: n("<[4@2 ~ 2 4@2 ~ 7] [5@4 ~ 4 2@2] [4@2 ~ 6 4@2 2@2] [3@4 2@2 ~@2]>")
  .scale("A:minor").s("triangle").timbre("soft")
  .attack(.02).decay(.4).sustain(.4).release(.4)
  .delay(.3).delaytime(3/8).room(.4).gain(.3)
  .sections("verse")

// The chorus lead; the last chorus adds an octave shimmer
lead: n("<[11@3 9 7@2 9 11] [12@4 11 9@3] [11@3 13 11@2 9@2] [10@4 8@2 ~@2]>")
  .scale("A:minor")
  .s("sawtooth").unison(2).detune(.15).mono(1).glide(.06)
  .vib(5).vibdepth(.15).lpf(2800)
  .delay(.35).delaytime(3/8).room(.5).gain(.28)
  .sections("chorus").variant(x => x.superimpose(y => y.add(12).gain(.12)))

// A noise riser through the bridge
riser: s("white").hpf(env("200 8000", "section")).gain(env("0 .15", "section"))
  .sections("bridge")

sketches.name: Rainy Window
sketches.description: Lo-fi study beats: dusty swung drums, descending Rhodes sevenths, a sleepy glass melody that forgets different notes each time, a soft interlude, vinyl crackle and rain, and a tape that slows to a stop.
sketches.source:
setcpm(78/4)
song("intro@4 loop@16 interlude@8 loop'@16 outro@4", "once")
// The tape slows down at the very end
tempomap("0:19.5 44:19.5 48:13")

// Dusty swung drums, bit-reduced and rolled off; softer in the interlude
drums: s("bd ~ [~ bd] ~, ~ sd ~ sd, hh*8")
  .swing(4).crush(9).lpf(3500).gain(bysec("interlude:.4 *:.65"))
  .exceptSections("intro outro")

// Rhodes sevenths sliding down: Fmaj7, Em7, Dm7, Cmaj7
keys: note("<[f3,a3,c4,e4] [e3,g3,b3,d4] [d3,f3,a3,c4] [c3,e3,g3,b3]>")
  .struct("x ~ ~ [~ x] ~ ~ x ~")
  .s("sine").fm(1.1).fmh(2).trem(4).tremdepth(.25)
  .decay(.8).sustain(.3).release(.6).lpf(2200).room(.4).gain(.36)

// Round sub bass
bass: note("<f2 e2 d2 c2>").struct("x ~ ~ x ~ [~ x] ~ ~")
  .s("sine").shape(.1).decay(.5).sustain(.3).release(.3).gain(.6)
  .exceptSections("intro")

// A sleepy glass melody that forgets a note now and then;
// the prime on the second loop makes it forget different ones
melody: n("~ [4 ~ 3] ~ 2 ~ ~ [0 1] ~").scale("A:minor pentatonic").transpose(12)
  .every(4, rev)
  .degradeBy(.2).seed("study")
  .s("triangle").timbre("glass").decay(.4).sustain(0).release(.8)
  .delay(.4).delaytime(3/8).delayfeedback(.4).room(.5).gain(.3)
  .sections("loop")

// The interlude: a slower, softer line
interlude: n("<[7 ~ 6 4] [~ 3 ~ 2] [4 ~ 3 ~] [0@2 ~@2]>").scale("A:minor pentatonic").transpose(12)
  .s("sine").fm(.5).fmh(3).decay(.6).sustain(0).release(1)
  .delay(.4).delaytime(3/8).delayfeedback(.45).room(.6).gain(.28)
  .sections("interlude")

// Vinyl crackle and rain outside
crackle: s("click*16?0.3").hpf(3000).gain(rand.range(.03, .1))
rain: s("rain").slow(4).intensity(.3).gain(.2)

sketches.name: Sunday Deep House
sketches.description: A deep house track built in sections: kick and ticks, then Dorian chord stabs through an opening filter, warm sub bass and an off-beat hat, a breakdown with a vocal 'ooh' and a clap roll, the drop and an outro.
sketches.source:
setcpm(122/4)
song("intro@16 groove@32 breakdown@16 drop@32 outro@16", "once")

// Kit: kick, off-beat open hat, clap and ticking sixteenths
kick: s("bd*4").gain(.8).exceptSections("breakdown")
ohat: s("[~ oh]*4").gain(.35).exceptSections("intro breakdown")
// The clap rolls into the next section
clap: s("~ cp ~ cp").room(.3).gain(.5)
  .atEnd(1, x => x.ply(4))
  .exceptSections("intro outro")
ticks: s("hh*16").hpf(8000).gain(perlin.range(.08, .25))

// Dorian stabs, Cm9 to F9, through a filter that opens across each section
stabs: note("<[c3,eb3,g3,bb3,d4] [eb3,g3,a3,c4,f4]>")
  .struct("~ ~ x ~ ~ ~ x ~ ~ ~ x ~ ~ x ~ ~")
  .s("sawtooth").lpf(env("600 2200", "section")).lpq(4)
  .decay(.25).sustain(0).release(.2)
  .delay(.3).delaytime(3/16).delayfeedback(.35).room(.4).gain(.28)
  .exceptSections("intro")

// Warm sub bass
bass: note("<[c2 ~ ~ c2 ~ ~ bb1 ~] [f1 ~ ~ f1 ~ ~ eb2 ~]>")
  .s("sine").shape(.2).decay(.3).sustain(.5).release(.1).gain(.6)
  .exceptSections("breakdown")

// A vocal 'ooh' answering the chords, from the breakdown on
vox: note("<[~ g4 ~ ~ bb4 ~ ~ ~] [~ a4 ~ ~ c5 ~ ~ ~]>")
  .s("ooh").attack(.05).release(.6)
  .delay(.4).delaytime(3/8).room(.5).gain(.28)
  .sections("breakdown drop")

sketches.name: Liquid Horizon
sketches.description: Liquid drum and bass in DJ-friendly sections: a pad intro, the drop with a two-step break and detuned reese, a rolling ride section, a breakdown with a distant voice, the second drop and an outro, with Rhodes arpeggios in the delay throughout.
sketches.source:
setcpm(174/4)
song("intro@16 drop@32 roller@32 break@16 drop'@32 outro@16", "once")

// Two-step break with ghost snares, and a double-time fill to close each section
beat: s("bd ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ bd ~ ~ ~ ~ ~, ~ ~ ~ ~ sd ~ ~ sd?0.3 ~ ~ ~ ~ sd ~ ~ sd?0.2")
  .gain(.8)
  .atEnd(1, x => x.ply(2))
  .exceptSections("intro break outro")
hats: s("hh*16?0.25").hpf(8000).gain(.3).exceptSections("break")
ride: s("[~ rd]*4").gain(.2).sections("roller drop'")

// Reese bass: detuned saws under a slow filter
reese: note("<e1 e1 c1 d1>").s("sawtooth").unison(4).detune(.4)
  .lpf(sine.range(200, 700).slow(4)).lpq(3)
  .attack(.05).sustain(1).release(.3).gain(.38)
  .exceptSections("intro break")

// Lush pads: Em7, Em7, Cmaj7, Dadd9
pads: note("<[e3,g3,b3,d4] [e3,g3,b3,d4] [c3,e3,g3,b3] [d3,f#3,a3,e4]>")
  .s("sawtooth").unison(3).detune(.2)
  .attack(.6).release(1.8).lpf(1600).room(.8).size(.9).gain(.18)

// Rhodes arpeggios bouncing through the delay
keys: n("0 2 4 6 7 6 4 2").add("<0 0 -2 -1>").scale("E:minor").transpose(12)
  .s("sine").fm(1).fmh(2).decay(.25).sustain(0)
  .pan(sine.slow(4)).delay(.45).delaytime(3/16).delayfeedback(.5).gain(.22)

// A distant voice, from the breakdown on
vox: note("<b4 ~ a4 [g4 f#4]>").s("ooh").attack(.4).release(2).room(.8).gain(.22)
  .sections("break drop'")

sketches.name: Midnight Trap Lantern
sketches.description: Half-time trap in hook and verse form: a dark FM bell hook that rises an octave each time it returns, verses on rolling hi-hats and a gliding 808, and a choir pad from the first bar to the last.
sketches.source:
setcpm(140/4)
song("intro@4 hook@8 verse@16 hook'@8 verse'@16 hook''@8 outro@4", "once")

// Half-time kit: the clap lands on beat three
drums: s("bd ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ bd ~ ~ bd ~ ~ ~ ~ ~, ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ [cp,sd] ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~")
  .room(.2).gain(.75)
  .exceptSections("intro outro")

// Hi-hats that roll into triplets and thirty-seconds, and race at each section end
hats: s("hh*8").sometimesBy(.35, x => x.ply("<2 3 4>"))
  .hpf(6000).pan(sine.range(.4, .6)).gain(.32)
  .atEnd(1, x => x.ply(2))
  .exceptSections("intro")

// The 808: a mono sine that glides between notes
b808: note("<[c2@6 c2 ~ eb2@4 ~ ~ g1@2] [ab1@6 ab1 ~ g1@6 bb1@2] [f1@6 f1 ~ ab1@4 ~ ~ c2@2] [g1@8 g1 ~ ~ g1 b1@2 d2@2]>")
  .s("sine").mono(1).glide(.08).shape(.3)
  .attack(.005).decay(1).sustain(.6).release(.2).gain(.55)
  .exceptSections("intro outro")

// A dark FM bell hook that rises an octave when it comes back
bell: n("<[0 ~ 3 ~ 2 ~ 0 ~] [~ 4 ~ 3 2 ~ ~ ~]>").scale("C:minor").transpose(12)
  .s("sine").fm(2).fmh(3).decay(.4).sustain(0)
  .delay(.3).delaytime(3/16).room(.5).gain(.24)
  .sections("intro hook outro").variant(x => x.add(12))

// A choir pad: Cm, Ab, Fm, G
pad: note("<[c3,eb3,g3] [ab2,c3,eb3] [f2,ab2,c3] [g2,b2,d3]>")
  .s("ooh").attack(.5).release(1.5).room(.6).gain(.2)

sketches.name: Funk Machine
sketches.description: E dorian funk with a count-in: a tight kit with ghost notes, a snapping bass, an auto-wah clavinet and horn punches every fourth bar, a breakdown to drums and bass, and a final band hit.
sketches.source:
setcpm(104/4)
song("count@1 groove@16 groove'@16 break@4 groove''@16 tag@1", "once")

// Count-in on the sticks
sticks: s("rim*4").gain(.4).sections("count")

// Tight kit with ghost notes on the snare and accented hats, with a fill to close each section
drums: stack(
  s("bd ~ ~ bd ~ ~ bd ~ ~ ~ bd ~ ~ ~ ~ ~, ~ ~ ~ ~ sd ~ ~ sd?0.3 ~ sd?0.25 ~ ~ sd ~ ~ ~").gain(.75),
  s("hh*16").hpf(7000).gain("[.35 .15]*8")
).atEnd(1, x => x.ply(2))
  .exceptSections("count tag")

// Snapping bass with a filter pluck
bass: note("e2 ~ e3 ~ ~ e2 g2 ~ a2 ~ ~ e2 ~ d3 b2 ~")
  .s("sawtooth").lpf(900).lpenv(2.5).lpdecay(.08)
  .decay(.15).sustain(.2).release(.05).gain(.55)
  .exceptSections("count tag")

// Clavinet through an auto-wah: Em7 and A7 shapes
clav: note("~ [g3,b3,d4] ~ [g3,b3,d4] [g3,b3,d4] ~ ~ [g3,b3,d4] ~ [g3,c#4,e4] ~ [g3,b3,d4] ~ ~ [g3,c#4,e4] ~")
  .s("square").pw(.2).lpf(sine.range(800, 3000).fast(2)).lpq(8)
  .attack(.002).decay(.08).sustain(0).pan(.35).gain(.2)
  .exceptSections("count break tag")

// Horn punches on every fourth bar, doubled up when the groove comes back
horns: note("<~ ~ ~ [~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ [b4,e5] [b4,e5] ~ [c#5,e5] ~ [d5,g5] ~ [e5,a5]@3]>")
  .s("sawtooth").unison(2).detune(.1)
  .lpf(1500).lpenv(2).lpattack(.02).lpdecay(.15)
  .attack(.01).release(.1).pan(.65).room(.3).gain(.3)
  .sections("groove").variant(x => x.ply(2))

// The tag: one last hit from the whole band
tagband: note("[e2,e3,b3,d4,g4]").struct("x ~ ~ ~")
  .s("sawtooth").unison(2).detune(.1).lpf(1800)
  .attack(.005).decay(.5).sustain(0).release(.4).room(.3).gain(.32)
  .sections("tag")
tagkit: s("[bd,cr] ~ ~ ~").gain(.6).sections("tag")

sketches.name: 8-Bit Quest
sketches.description: A chiptune adventure in levels: a title screen, a pulse-wave hero theme that changes duty cycle and gains an echo on each new level, a faster boss fight in A minor, and a victory fanfare.
sketches.source:
setcpm(150/4)
song("title@4 level@16 level'@16 boss@16 level''@16 victory@4", "once")
// The boss fight steps the tempo up, then it drops back for the last level
tempomap("0:37.5 36:37.5 36:42 52:42 52:37.5")

// Hero theme on a pulse wave: a thinner duty cycle on level two, an echo on level three
lead: note("<[c5 ~ g4 c5 e5 ~ d5 c5] [d5 ~ b4 g4 d5 ~ f5 e5] [e5 g5 e5 c5 a4 ~ c5 e5] [d5 c5 b4 g4 c5@3 ~]>")
  .s("square").pw(.25).decay(.1).sustain(.6).release(.05)
  .vib(6).vibdepth(.05).gain(.2)
  .sections("level").variant(x => x.pw(.125), x => x.off(1/8, y => y.gain(.08)))

// Fast broken-chord harmony: C, G, Am, G
arp: note("<[c4 e4 g4 e4]*2 [b3 d4 g4 d4]*2 [a3 c4 e4 c4]*2 [b3 d4 g4 d4]*2>")
  .s("square").pw(.5).decay(.05).sustain(0).pan(.35).gain(.11)
  .exceptSections("boss victory")

// Triangle bass jumping octaves
bass: note("<[c2 c3]*4 [g1 g2]*4 [a1 a2]*4 [g1 g2]*4>")
  .s("triangle").decay(.1).sustain(.5).release(.05).gain(.5)
  .exceptSections("title boss victory")

// The boss: A minor and E major, faster and darker
bosslead: note("<[a4 ~ e5 a4 c5 ~ b4 a4] [g#4 ~ b4 e5 g#5 ~ f5 e5] [a4 c5 e5 a5 g#5 e5 b4 g#4] [g#4 ~ b4 ~ e5@4]>")
  .s("square").pw(.125).decay(.1).sustain(.6).release(.05).gain(.2)
  .sections("boss")
bossbass: note("<[a1 a2]*4 [e1 e2]*4 [a1 a2]*4 [e1 e2]*4>")
  .s("triangle").decay(.1).sustain(.5).release(.05).gain(.5)
  .sections("boss")

// Victory fanfare: Ab, Bb, C
fanfare: note("<[c5 c5 c5 c5@2 ab4@3] [bb4@3 c5@2 bb4 c5@2] [e4,g4,c5] ~>")
  .s("square").pw(.25).decay(.2).sustain(.6).release(.3).gain(.22)
  .sections("victory")
fanfarebass: note("<[ab1 ab2]*4 [bb1 bb2]*4 c2 ~>")
  .s("triangle").decay(.1).sustain(.5).release(.3).gain(.5)
  .sections("victory")

// Noise-channel drums, with a fill every fourth bar
kick: note("c2 ~ [~ c2] ~").s("sine").penv(30).pdecay(.04).decay(.15).sustain(0).gain(.6)
  .exceptSections("title victory")
snare: s("~ white ~ white").hpf(2000).decay(.1).sustain(0).gain(.25)
  .every(4, x => x.ply(2))
  .exceptSections("title victory")
hats: s("white*8").hpf(9000).decay(.02).sustain(0).gain(.1)
  .exceptSections("victory")

sketches.name: Cathedral of Light
sketches.description: Organ pedals and bells open the service; a choir breathes slow D minor chords while a lone voice sings 'Ave Maria, gratia plena', then sings it again doubled below, and the choir closes with an 'amen' that brightens to D major.
sketches.source:
setcpm(56/4)
song("pedal@4 choir@8 ave@8 ave'@8 amen@4", "once")
tempomap("0:14 28:14 32:9")

// A choir breathing slow chords in D minor
choir: note("<[d3,a3,f4] [bb2,f3,d4] [g2,d3,bb3] [a2,e3,c#4]>").slow(2)
  .s("choir").syl("<ah oh oo ah>")
  .attack(1.5).release(3).space("church").gain(.38)
  .exceptSections("pedal amen")

// A single voice sings above it: a-ve ma-ri-a, gra-ti-a ple-na;
// the second time it is doubled an octave below
solo: note("<a4 [bb4 a4] g4 [f4 e4] d4 ~ e4 [f4 g4]>")
  .s("voice").syl("<a [ve ma] ri [a gra] ti ~ a [ple na]>")
  .voicetype("alto").mono(1).vglide(.1)
  .attack(.2).release(1).space("church").gain(.4)
  .sections("ave").variant(x => x.superimpose(y => y.add(-12).gain(.2)))

// Amen: a plagal cadence over the tonic pedal that brightens to D major
amen: note("<[g2,d3,bb3,g4] [g2,d3,bb3,g4] [d3,a3,d4,f#4] [d3,a3,d4,f#4]>")
  .s("choir").syl("<a a men men>")
  .attack(.8).release(4).space("church").gain(.38)
  .sections("amen")

// Organ pedal notes underneath
pedal: note("<d2 bb1 g1 a1>").slow(2).s("sawtooth").timbre("organ")
  .lpf(500).attack(1).release(3).gain(.28)

// Distant bells and an overtone hum
bells: note("<d5 ~ a4 ~ ~ f5 ~ ~>").s("sine").fm(3.5).fmh(2.41)
  .decay(3).sustain(0).release(3).space("church").gain(.15)
hum: note("d2").slow(8).s("hum").overtone(6).gain(.2)

sketches.name: Forest Morning
sketches.description: Headphones on: from dawn to noon. A stream and a robin at first light, then a lark circling, a distant woodpecker and a pastoral flute with harp; the flute climbs an octave and insects wake as the day warms.
sketches.source:
setcpm(80/4)
song("dawn@8 morning@16 morning'@16 noon@8", "once")

// A stream and a light breeze set the scene
stream: s("stream").slow(4).gain(.28)
breeze: s("wind").slow(8).intensity(.3).gain(.1)

// Birds placed around the listener: one ahead-left, one circling high on the right
robin: s("bird").slow(2).azimuth(-40).distance(3).gain(.45)
lark: s("bird").slow(3).azimuth(saw.range(30, 150).slow(6)).elevation(30).distance(5).posglide(.3).gain(.35)
  .exceptSections("dawn")

// Insects wake close to the ground as the day warms; a woodpecker far off
insects: s("insect").slow(4).azimuth(100).distance(2).gain(.14)
  .sections("morning' noon")
woodpecker: s("rim*6?0.6 ~ ~ ~").mask("<0 1 0 0>").speed(2).lpf(3000).azimuth(70).distance(6).gain(.22)
  .sections("morning")

// A wooden flute plays a pastoral tune over a harp, climbing an octave the second time
flute: note("<[g4@2 a4 b4 d5@3 b4] [c5@2 b4 a4 g4@4] [e4 g4 a4 b4 a4@2 g4 e4] [d4@6 ~@2]>")
  .s("sine").timbre("hollow").vib(5).vibdepth(.15)
  .attack(.06).sustain(.6).release(.5)
  .delay(.25).delaytime(3/8).room(.6).gain(.32)
  .sections("morning").variant(x => x.add(12).gain(.24))
harp: note("<[g3 b3 d4 b3] [c4 e4 g4 e4] [e3 g3 b3 g3] [d3 f#3 a3 f#3]>")
  .s("triangle").timbre("soft").decay(.4).sustain(0).release(.5).room(.5).gain(.22)
  .exceptSections("dawn")

sketches.name: Orbital Station
sketches.description: Headphones on: approach, dock, life aboard and departure. A binaural drone through the hull, a pad that opens over the whole visit, telemetry blips, an airlock cycling, crackling radio chatter and engines that fall away behind you.
sketches.source:
setcpm(70/4)
song("approach@8 dock@16 station@16 departure@8", "once")

// A binaural drone hums through the hull
drone: note("<c2 c2 ab1 bb1>").slow(2).s("sine").binaural(4)
  .attack(2).sustain(1).release(3).gain(.4)

// Wide pad that opens over the whole visit and closes as you leave
pad: note("[c3,g3,d4,eb4]").slow(4).s("sawtooth").unison(4).detune(.35)
  .lpf(env("300 1200 600", "song")).attack(3).release(4).room(.8).size(.95).gain(.15)
  .exceptSections("approach")

// Telemetry: random blips from a pentatonic computer
blips: n(irand(10).segment(16)).scale("C:minor pentatonic").transpose(24)
  .degradeBy(.6).seed("orbit")
  .s("sine").decay(.05).sustain(0).release(.05)
  .pan(rand).delay(.3).delaytime(1/8).delayfeedback(.4).gain(.18)
  .sections("dock station")

// The engines, somewhere behind you; distant on approach, falling away on departure
engine: s("engine").slow(8).azimuth(180).distance(bysec("approach:6 departure:8 *:3")).gain(.25)

// Crackling radio chatter while docking
radio: s("whisper*4?0.4").syl("<sha ko ta ri>").crush(5).hpf(900).pan(.8).gain(.14)
  .sections("approach dock")

// An airlock cycling as you board and as you leave
airlock: s("white").slow(8).hpf(env("200 5000", "section")).gain(.05)
  .sections("dock departure")
